# Pulse Electric Inc.

> > Professional electrical contracting services for residential and commercial clients in Tucson, Arizona, led by IBEW-trained electricians.

Pulse Electric Inc. is a family-owned electrical services company based in Tucson, AZ, offering comprehensive solutions from residential repairs and panel upgrades to commercial installations and EV charging systems. The company is staffed by certified electricians affiliated with the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers.
